//: Type-checking scope for the web app + its build script + its tests. The root tsconfig.json's `include` is deliberately scoped to `src` only (owned by the CLI/catalog side of this repo), so this sibling config covers `web/`, `scripts/build-web.ts`, and `test/web-*.test.ts` without touching the shared root config. Run via `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json`.
